title: DonkeyKong-ish
name: DonkeyKongish-2.0.0.zip
description: Game based on the legendary Donkey Kong.
author: Martin Butler
details: This was a game I originally wrote in Java; my then 9 year old son designed the levels. Sorry I can't remember where I got the sprites, other elements were drawn by my son. I've ported it over to the Wii U. I got the music from Donkey Kong Soundboard.
requirements: Aroma for the bundled WUHB. Keep the complete package; any separate RPX variant needs the environment documented by the project.
setup: Extract the complete SD bundle to the SD root; keep every app folder, music file and companion asset. Launch the matching executable from its documented environment.
